name: es-runtime-repo
description: The workspace root. The runtime itself is Rust; tasks are in tasks.toml.
_workspaces: website/ and bench/ are deliberately not members and keep their own bun.lock. website/ must stay on lockfileVersion 1 — its deploy cannot read 2, and folding it in here would move its dependencies into this v2 lockfile and break the build. bench/ is the cross-runtime comparison clients, which have no business in the runtime's dependency graph.
